items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: He used to play with the Superior Baron.

ctx.x: I know he went over there because he taught Tommy Ladner over there.
He used to play. He used to play with the Superior Baron. Bunk hit.
Did you know a clarinet player from Bay St. Louis named Sumner Labatt? Remember him? Kind of straight clarinet player.
